now.title: Now
now.desc: Your coding agents, their pull requests and deploys, across every account you connected.

card.pending: {n, plural, one {# reply queued} other {# replies queued}}
card.unread: {n, plural, one {# unread message} other {# unread messages}}

empty.title: Nothing connected yet
empty.body: Connect Claude Code with a one-line hook, and your GitHub and Vercel accounts, to see what your agents are doing and talk to them.
empty.noAgents: No agent sessions yet. Install the Claude Code hook and start a session: it shows up here.
empty.noPrs: No open pull requests in the repositories you picked.
empty.noGithub: Connect a GitHub account to see pull requests, checks and releases.
empty.noDeploys: No deploys yet in the projects you picked.
empty.noVercel: Connect a Vercel account to see deploys and what is serving production.

prs.desc: Open pull requests from every GitHub account, with checks, auto-merge and conflicts.

deploys.desc: Deploys from every Vercel account and team, and the one serving production in each project.

chats.pickBody: Pick a conversation. Your replies wait in a queue and the agent gets them as soon as it stops.
chats.deleteBody: It is removed from Fleet. The agent session on your computer is not touched.
chats.hintWorking: The agent is working. Your message is delivered when it stops.
chats.hintIdle: Your message is delivered the next time the agent stops or you send it a prompt.

settings.title: Settings
settings.desc: Connect your local agents, your GitHub accounts and your Vercel teams. Everything here is yours: other people in the workspace do not see it.
settings.agentsDesc: Create a token and run the install command on each computer where your agents run. It adds a hook to Claude Code that also works inside Orca, and keeps your other hooks.
settings.revokeBody: The hook on that computer stops sending events right away. Sessions already in Fleet stay.
settings.installLead: Run this in a terminal on that computer:
settings.installOnce: The token is shown only now. It is saved on your computer with permissions only you can read.
settings.sent1: The event (session started, prompt, notification, stop), the session id and its status.
settings.sent2: The folder name and the git branch, never the full path or your files.
settings.sent3: Your prompt and the agent's last message, cut to a few thousand characters, with common secrets like tokens and keys removed.
settings.sent4: Orca's pane, tab and worktree ids when the agent runs inside Orca.
settings.replyHow: When you reply in a chat, the next time the agent stops the hook hands it your message and the agent keeps working with it.
settings.githubDesc: Add one or more accounts or organizations with a fine-grained token (read only: Pull requests, Actions, Contents, Commit statuses and Metadata). Fleet checks them every 5 minutes.
settings.githubHelp: Create it in GitHub › Settings › Developer settings › Fine-grained tokens, with access to the repositories you want to watch.
settings.vercelDesc: Add one or more Vercel accounts or teams with a token. Fleet reads projects and deploys every 5 minutes and never changes anything.
settings.vercelHelp: Create it in Vercel › Account settings › Tokens, scoped to the team you want to watch.
settings.pickRepos: Pick up to {max} repositories to watch.
settings.pickProjects: Pick the projects to watch. With none picked, Fleet watches all of them.
settings.disconnectBody: Fleet deletes the token and what it synced from this account.

link.title: Inbox, Lines and WhatsApp
link.desc: Show your agent conversations next to your other chats, and get a WhatsApp message when an agent needs you.
link.mirrorInbox: Show an Agents row at the top of Inbox
link.mirrorLines: Show an Agents row at the top of Lines

notifyOptions.waiting: When an agent is waiting for you
notifyOptions.both: When an agent finishes or waits for you

link.noWhatsapp: Connect your WhatsApp in Inbox to get messages on your phone.
link.notifyHelp: The message goes to your own chat (Message yourself), never to anyone else. Reply to it quoting the message and your answer goes to that agent.

notifyWa.howToReply: Reply quoting this message to answer the agent.

errors.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Wait a minute.
errors.github_unauthorized: GitHub rejected the token. Check that it is valid and not expired.
errors.github_forbidden: The token cannot read that. Give it access to the repositories and read permissions.
errors.github_rate_limited: GitHub's rate limit was reached. Fleet tries again later.
errors.vercel_unauthorized: Vercel rejected the token. Check that it is valid and not expired.
errors.vercel_forbidden: The token cannot read that team.
errors.vercel_rate_limited: Vercel's rate limit was reached. Fleet tries again later.
errors.too_many_connections: You reached the limit of 20 accounts.
errors.too_many_tokens: You reached the limit of 10 tokens. Revoke one first.
errors.team_not_found: The token has no access to that team.
errors.repo_not_found: A repository was not found or the token cannot see it.
errors.too_many_pending: There are already 20 messages waiting for this agent.
